comment: More Flame Altars' own symbol, loaded only when altars above 16 are switched on (Symbols.LoadShipped). AltarLimit is the game's altar-limit function: min(BalancingTable.altarsPerFlameLevel[flameLevel], 16), BalancingRegistry* in rcx, the Flame level in edx, the limit as a zero-extended u32 in eax (server 0x93dea0 / client 0xe96c80 on builds 26430253 / 26430625; identical bytes on both sides). altars.table is the table's offset of altarsPerFlameLevel (0x1b8).
